# /crav1-suggest-tests-for-code

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From code that already exists, suggest tests](../../from-suggest-tests.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

The user points at code that already exists, one repo or one area, not the whole system.

When the user points at code that already exists, one repo or one area, **[`/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code`](crav1-suggest-tests-for-code.md)** reads that code and suggests tests for what that code can actually break. A function gets a few checks. A page gets a browser check. A boundary gets an integration check. It does not dump every test type. Every suggestion stays listed. Nothing is dropped to keep the list short. The user takes them one at a time: keep, leave, or dismiss. Dismiss means it is not offered again. A kept suggestion goes onto the existing spec through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md). Plan turns it into a task. It does not write the tests, change the code, or start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is cross-cutting. It may run from any lane. It does not move work into a lane. It is a later skill. It is not a starter option. Asking for startup options names only the six and does not run this command. The six starter options stay unchanged.

## Runs when

The user points at existing code. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 1 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: That code, its tests, and the spec.

Reads one repo or one area of code that already exists, the tests with that code, and the existing spec.

## Writes

In short: Nothing itself; a kept or dismissed suggestion goes onto the spec through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md).

Writes nothing itself.

## Does not

Leaves tests, application code, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md` alone.

Limits and exceptions: the whole system, no code pointed at, or no existing spec stops with no list. Leave writes nothing and is offered again. Dismiss is not offered again. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. Plan turns a kept suggestion into a task. It is not a starter option.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-plan-from-spec`](crav1-plan-from-spec.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) for one kept suggestion and for one dismissed suggestion.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Testing helpers. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.17.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code
@<one repo or one area>
@docs/specs/<slug>/

Suggest tests for what this code can break. Do not write the tests. Do not change the code.
```
